## lumbar_flexion
Screening-level contraindications for the movement class "Loaded or end-range lumbar flexion".
Machine-generated by movement class, NOT a clinician review of this specific exercise.

Screen before prescribing:
  - acute lumbar disc herniation or radiculopathy, where flexion reproduces leg symptoms
  - osteoporosis or known vertebral fragility — repeated loaded flexion carries vertebral compression fracture risk
  - post lumbar fusion or discectomy while flexion precautions remain in force
  - acute lumbar muscle spasm with protective posturing

Applies to any prescribed movement:
  - unexplained or worsening pain, especially at night or at rest
  - recent trauma with suspected fracture
  - acute infection, fever, or systemic illness
  - new or progressive neurological symptoms (weakness, numbness, loss of bladder or bowel control)
  - medical instruction to restrict activity, or post-operative precautions not yet lifted

## lumbar_extension
Screening-level contraindications for the movement class "Lumbar extension".
Machine-generated by movement class, NOT a clinician review of this specific exercise.

Screen before prescribing:
  - spondylolysis or spondylolisthesis — extension loads the pars and can provoke symptoms
  - lumbar spinal stenosis, where extension narrows the canal and reproduces neurogenic claudication
  - acute facet joint irritation with extension-provoked pain
  - recent lumbar surgery with extension precautions in force

Applies to any prescribed movement:
  - unexplained or worsening pain, especially at night or at rest
  - recent trauma with suspected fracture
  - acute infection, fever, or systemic illness
  - new or progressive neurological symptoms (weakness, numbness, loss of bladder or bowel control)
  - medical instruction to restrict activity, or post-operative precautions not yet lifted

## cervical_mobility
Screening-level contraindications for the movement class "Cervical spine movement".
